title: Vision Plans Contact-Lens Fitting Member Cost by Kind and Location
content:
How the member share of the fitting line on a Vision Plans contact-lens order is worked out depends on the fitting's kind and location:

1. **Specialty fitting at a participating independent practice.** The fitting is first priced at its contracted fee: the billed charge less 10% of it. The member pays the part of that contracted fee above the combined fitting allowance, never below 0.00.
2. **Specialty fitting at a participating retail-chain location.** It receives no fitting allowance, and the member pays its contracted fee (the billed charge less 10% of it).
3. **Every other fitting.** It follows the fitting benefit for its kind: the member pays the part of the billed charge above the combined fitting allowance, never below 0.00, and for a standard fitting at most the plan's standard fitting maximum.

| Kind | Independent practice | Retail-chain location |
|---|---|---|
| Specialty | Contracted fee less the combined allowance, floor 0.00 | Contracted fee, no allowance |
| Standard | Billed charge less the combined allowance, floor 0.00, capped at the standard maximum | Same |

*Hypothetical figures.* A specialty fitting billed 168.20 at an independent practice has a contracted fee of 151.38; with a combined fitting allowance of 65.00, the member pays 86.38. The same fitting at a retail-chain location costs 151.38. A standard fitting billed 96.85 with a combined allowance of 50.00 leaves the member 46.85, within a standard maximum of 60.00.
